services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Grandparents/Family Camp is the perfect way to spend quality time with family and bring out your youthful spirit this summer. It is also a great introduction to camp for younger campers and campers who haven't been to camp before! Families get the full camp experience, staying in a cabin together and participating in camp activities such as archery, ropes course, swimming, boating, arts & crafts, and more. Days at Grandparents/Family Camp are fairly flexible to allow for a mix of family time and all-together time. $300 for adults and $200 for children 12 and under. services.name: Site Rentals
services.desc: Camp Wilmot is located in New Hampshire and has over 200 acres of beautiful woodlands, including an 11 acre lake. There is a sandy waterfront area which is equipped with swimming docks as well as both canoes and kayaks. There is a large sports field, hiking trails and various firepits around the site. There are 12 cabins (each with their own bathroom and shower). The original barn is a rustic space for fires or group gatherings. The farmhouse has bedrooms, kitchen and the dining hall. The dining hall has space for up to 100 people. During the winter our site can be used for cross country skiing, snow shoeing and ice skating as well as the very popular activity of sledging down Vesper Hill.

services.name: Blue Cabin
services.desc: Camp Wilmot is now offering an opportunity for you to adopt a cabin at camp and become a Camp Wilmot sponsor. As a sponsor you will have the opportunity to attend a sponsors-only weekend event and receive a discount on all winter rentals! All funds raised from Adopt a Cabin go directly in to upgrading our facilities. Last year we replaced all the screen doors on the cabins and put new windows in to the farmhouse bedrooms. All rooms were decorated and new rugs, lamps and curtains were purchased. So far this year we have lifted two cabins and put them on to new foundations and are working towards replacing the siding on another cabin. The blue cabin is fully resided. Waterfront Cabins, White
